sections.title: One useful new feeling
sections.content: *izgul* ("to be nervous, anxious") is a natural word for meeting someone's family the first time. It conjugates like a regular verb such as *tanul* (*tanulok*, *tanulsz*, *tanul*): *izgulok*, *izgulsz*, *izgul*...

items.spanish: Károly szülei nagyon kedvesek, ezért most nem izgulok.
items.english: Károly's parents are very kind, so now I'm not nervous.

sections.content: *egy kicsit* ("a little") softens almost any feeling word — *egy kicsit fáradt vagyok*, *egy kicsit izgulok* — a handy way to hedge without needing a whole new grammar structure.
